coverage_explanation: Tests every decimal digit through serial input, nonsequential transitions, repeated input, and return to a previously displayed digit. Exercises both newline and idle framing, verifies decoded common-anode segment output, and checks all eight required output pin modes. Undefined startup glyphs, nonnumeric input, and decimal-point behavior are not constrained.
assumptions: The supplied wiring overrides bench defaults: A through G connect to pins 2 through 8, DP connects to pin 9, and COM connects to 5V.
Single ASCII decimal digits are valid one-digit serial values. Inputs use the disclosed 9600 baud and line_or_idle framing with a 20 ms idle timeout.
No startup display value, invalid-input behavior, or decimal-point behavior is specified; these are not asserted.
A 300 ms settling allowance is used because no exact display response latency is specified.
